title: ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ Season 4 is confirmed. Here’s what we know
summary: Prime Video’s epic fantasy series is in pre-production at Shepperton Studios in the UK, with filming set to begin this spring.
body_markdown:
---


## Key Takeaways:


- Prime Video has confirmed Season 4 of


The Rings of Power


, which is now in pre-production.


- Season 4 begins filming this spring at Shepperton Studios in the UK, the series’ production home.


- All 24 episodes of Seasons 1–3 are available to stream on Prime Video.


---


[The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/where-to-watch-lord-of-the-rings) is coming back for a fourth season.


Prime Video announced today that Season 4 is in pre-production and will start filming this spring at Shepperton Studios in the UK, where the series is made.


[How to watch ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ Season 3, streaming now on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/lord-of-the-rings-rings-of-power-season-3-prime-video)


The latest season of Prime Video’s epic saga features new characters including Jamie Campbell Bower as Celeborn.


The news comes the same day the last two episodes of Season 3 arrive on Prime Video. In those episodes,


[Sauron](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/sauron-lord-of-the-rings-rings-of-power) finally forges the One Ring, a moment fans have waited three seasons to see.


Here’s everything we know so far about


The Rings of Power


Season 4, plus how to watch every episode now.


## When will ‘The Rings of Power’ Season 4 be released?


Prime Video hasn’t announced a release date for Season 4 yet. Filming begins this spring at Shepperton Studios in the UK. We'll update this story when we know more.


## What is ‘The Rings of Power’ Season 4 about?


Season 4 will continue the story following the conclusion of Season 3, which showcases the forging of the iconic One Ring for the first time on screen in its finale.


Further story details for Season 4 have not yet been announced. We’ll update this story as we learn more.


## Who is in ‘The Rings of Power’ Season 4 cast?


The Season 4 cast has not yet been announced.


We’ll update this story as cast members are confirmed.


## How to watch ‘The Rings of Power’ Season 4 on Prime Video


Details on how to watch Season 4 of


The Rings of Power


on Prime Video are yet to be confirmed.


We'll update this story as we learn more.


## Who is the team behind ‘The Rings of Power’ Season 4?


The team behind Season 4 is yet to be confirmed.


The third season of


The Rings of Power


was produced by showrunners and executive producers J.D. Payne and Patrick McKay.


They were joined by executive producers Lindsey Weber, Kate Hazell, Justin Doble, and executive producer-director Charlotte Brändström.


Matthew Penry-Davey was producer and Ally O’Leary Cantrell, Tim Keene, and Andrew Lee were co-producers.


## What is ‘The Rings of Power’?


Prime Video series


The Rings of Power


brings to screens for the very first time the heroic legends of the fabled Second Age of Middle-earth’s history.


This epic drama is set thousands of years before the events of J.R.R. Tolkien’s


The Hobbit


and


The Lord of the Rings


books, taking viewers back to an era in which great powers were forged, kingdoms rose to glory and fell to ruin, unlikely heroes were tested, hope hung by the finest of threads, and the greatest villain that ever flowed from Tolkien’s pen threatened to cover all the world in darkness.


The series follows an ensemble cast of characters, both familiar and new, as they confront the long-feared re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains to the majestic forests of the elf capital of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the farthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.
